question.question: How do forest adjacency and Winter river affect Vagabond Slip, and does Fall add any special map rule?

expected.expected_answer: Forest adjacent to touching clearings without crossing printed path and forests separated by one printed path. Winter river divides forests as paths do; Fall has no special rule. Slip uses this adjacency. Rivers otherwise are not paths.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle (forest adjacency)
source_passages.quotation: Clearings have fox, rabbit or mouse suit and limited building slots. Buildings require open slots; tokens do not occupy these. Ruins block their slots and can be removed only when explicitly allowed. A forest is enclosed by printed paths and clearings; it is adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing a printed path and to forests separated by just one printed path. Winter's river also divides forests.
Use Fall or Winter. Fall has no special rules; on Winter, the river divides forests just as printed paths do. Rivers are otherwise not paths.

answer.ruling: A forest is enclosed by printed paths and clearings. It is adjacent to clearings that touch it without crossing a printed path, and to forests separated by just one printed path.
